item.title: Railways step in amid Indigo crisis; Deploy four special trains to ease rush
item.description: In response to the increasing rush and high demand for tickets, the Indian Railways took immediate action. Starting December 6, 2025, the Railways implemented the decision to add additional coaches and run additional trips on several routes. This has brought significant relief to passengers.

item.title: Read The Top News Headlines For Saturday 6 December In One Click
item.description: Stay updated with the biggest headlines for Saturday, 6 December—politics, crime, sports, and more—all summarized for quick reading. Get instant access to breaking news, major developments, and trending stories in just one click. Perfect for busy readers who want news on the go.

item.title: Gold gains marginally, Silver declines amid global market swings; Check rates here
item.description: Gold prices saw a slight increase on Saturday morning, while silver became cheaper. 24-karat gold rose by ₹10 to ₹1,29,940 per 10 grams, while silver fell by ₹100 to ₹1,86,900 per kilogram.

item.title: Bengal Set for Massive Gathering: 3 lakh devotees, global religious leaders to attend Babri Masjid foundation stone laying today
item.description: A grand program has been organized on 25 bighas of land in the Moradighi area of ​​Beldanga in the district for the foundation stone laying ceremony of the Babri Masjid. On the other hand, the administration has deployed a large number of police personnel to maintain law and order in the area.

item.title: Right to Disconnect Bill tabled; Employees may legally ignore after-hours calls
item.description: Several important private member bills were introduced in Parliament on Friday, the most prominent of which was the 'Right to Disconnect Bill 2025' introduced by Supriya Sule. This bill proposes to give employees the legal right to disconnect from office calls and emails after working hours.

item.title: Dense fog in hills, cold wave in plains; Weather forecast for Delhi, UP and other states
item.description: The Meteorological Department says that cold wave conditions are likely in some places in Punjab, Haryana, Chandigarh and Delhi, as well as in northwestern Jharkhand and northern Odisha. A cold wave alert has also been issued for Uttar Pradesh and eastern Rajasthan on December 6 and 7.

item.title: Delhi chokes as AQI hits ‘Very Poor’ category; Mundka records worst air quality
item.description: Delhi's air quality was recorded in the ‘very poor’ category on Saturday, with the average AQI reaching 333. The drop in temperature to 5.6°C further exacerbated the effects of the cold, fog, and pollution. 35 out of 39 monitoring stations recorded ‘very poor’ air quality, while Mundka was the most polluted with an AQI of 381.

item.title: Not Kohli-Rohit, 14-year-old player becomes India’s most searched cricketer
item.description: In 2025, 14-year-old young batsman Vaibhav Suryanshi topped the list of most searched cricketers in India. Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma did not feature in this list. Vaibhav delivered a stellar performance for Rajasthan Royals in IPL 2025 and scored the second fastest century in IPL history against Gujarat Titans in just 35 balls.

item.title: IndiGo chaos enters day 5, several flights cancelled Nationwide even today; Full details inside
item.description: Thousands of passengers are stranded at airports across the country. Many of them are rushing to nearby railway stations to catch trains to their destinations.

item.title: Shashi Tharoor introduces marital rape criminalization Bill in Lok Sabha; Key details explained
item.description: Congress MP Shashi Tharoor has introduced three private member bills in the Lok Sabha, the most important of which is a bill to criminalize marital rape. Tharoor said that a woman's consent remains essential even after marriage and the principle of 'no means no' should apply.
